scenarios.prompt: A weapon upgrades in place while armor uses replacement drops. Define stable instance IDs, slot compatibility and transactional upgrades without forcing one progression model everywhere.

criteria.identity: Equipment uses stable instance/definition identity independent from localized names or list positions.
criteria.transactions: Upgrade/fuse/reroll operations consume inputs and produce/update outputs exactly once.
